ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Deep Drill
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
DEEP_DRILL_HOME_BIOME_1, owner decision by question card (2026-10-03, again 2026-10-09; minerals design section 7 Q4 option A): deep drilling finds iron everywhere; every other deep deposit only in its home biome.
A Harmony postfix on CompDeepScanner.ChooseLumpThingDef looks the lump vanilla picked up in RM_DeepHomeTable (defs, generated from design/RimMandrake/mineral_abundance_registry_2026-10-03.csv). Off the deposit's home biomes the pick becomes steel. Deposits the table does not name are untouched. One Mod Settings switch; off is vanilla.
